title: Rejetto HTTP File Server RCE
rules_yaml:
title: Initial Access via Rejetto HFS Command Injection CVE-2014-6287
id: 5a3e9f8d-8b4c-4e6a-9f2d-1a7e8f3c4b5a
status: experimental
description: Detects exploitation of CVE-2014-6287 in Rejetto HTTP File Server via unauthenticated HTTP GET request with null byte injection and command execution syntax in the search parameter.
references:
    - https://vk9-sec.com/hfs-code-execution-cve-2014-6287/
    - https://www.exploit-db.com/exploits/39161
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1203/
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1059/003/
author: Sigma Assistant
date: 2026-09-29
tags:

    - attack.execution

    - attack.t1059.003
logsource:

detection:

            - 'search=%00{.+exec|'
    condition: selection
falsepositives:

level: high

id: 5a8d4e67-9b1c-4f0e-9d7a-3c2e5f1a8b4d
status: experimental
description: Detects execution of Shamoon or StoneDrill wiper malware by matching known Kaspersky Lab detection signatures found in file content, which are indicators of the actual malicious payload.
references:

    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1078/002/

    - attack.t1486

    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:

        CommandLine|contains:
            - 'Trojan.Win32.Shamoon.a'
            - 'Trojan.Win64.Shamoon.a'
            - 'Trojan.Win32.EraseMBR.a'
            - 'Backdoor.Win32.RemoteConnection.d'
